description:
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and three Foods, causing you to add twelve mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and Food tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and Food tokens.
Resolve the Samwise ability, returning Radiant Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Radiant Lotus by paying {6}.
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and an artifact token, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 3.
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and three tapped Food tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
